hooks.name: Engine tests on save
hooks.description: When a file in src/engine/ is saved, run the engine tests (including the fast-check property tests) and report failures.

action.command: if out=$(npm run --silent test:engine 2>&1); then echo "Engine tests passed."; else echo "Engine tests FAILED after saving a file in src/engine/:" >&2; printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -n 80 >&2; exit 1; fi
